intentionalTestDeletions.reason: The event-backed replay lifecycle service replaces the holder-backed execution saga and its integration test.
The explicit replay lease credential replaces the legacy implicit task-holder CLI guard and its integration test.
Explicit opaque gate receipts replace the legacy local completion-gate evaluator and its CLI integration test.
Immutable task events carry the canonical progress snapshot, so publication no longer replays or guards a Markdown append delta.
The single rebuildable SQLite reducer replaces the incremental projector fallback and its separate integration test.
